description: Routes the input to a linked node using the temp state of the pipeline or participant data

name.description: Identifies the node within its pipeline. Another node reaches this one's result through `temp_state.outputs.<name>`, so renaming it breaks any template that does.
name.title: Node Name

keywords.description: The routes this node can take, one per output. Uppercased and deduplicated on save. Entry `i` is served by output handle `output_i`, so adding, removing or reordering keywords rewires the node's outgoing edges.
keywords.title: Keywords

default_keyword_index.description: Position in `keywords` to fall back to when no route matches. Must be a valid index into `keywords`.
default_keyword_index.title: Default Keyword Index

tag_output_message.description: Tag the output message with the selected route
tag_output_message.title: Tag Output Message

data_source.title: DataSource
data_source.description: The source of the data to use for routing

route_key.description: The key in the data to use for routing
route_key.title: Route Key

title: StaticRouterNode
